channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Nederland closer to removing Caribou Village fire debris, but the future remains uncertain
item.description: Site stabilization that concluded Friday will allow safe access to parts of the demolished building where asbestos could be lurking

item.title: Would a new bill block Colorado cities from treating prostitution as a crime?
item.description: Yes. A bill brought by four Democratic lawmakers would remove all criminal penalties for sex work in Colorado and void local laws against it.

item.title: Colorado governor wants to change a local tax benefiting schools to help the state’s budget deficit
item.description: Gov. Jared Polis proposes changing the way vehicle registration tax is counted toward education funding. District leaders fear it means cuts to their budgets.

item.title: Can Colorado mute Trump’s orders to revive coal burning? A new bill will try.
item.description: Environmental groups and legislators back proposal to force coal plants that stay open to run cleaner, show their higher costs

item.title: Proposed tax breaks for data centers would increase taxes for poor Coloradans, analysts say
item.description: Sponsors of industry-backed data center bill say they are amending it in ways that will change the fiscal projections

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court will hear landmark Boulder climate case against oil companies
item.description: Many observers expect conservative justices to slap back idea of cities and states suing over climate change, but they get their day in high court

item.title: Sen. Bennet warns Coloradans to heed travel advisories after killing of Mexican cartel leader spurs violence
item.description: Multiple airlines have issued travel advisories, canceled flights or suspended service altogether due to the unrest in several parts of Mexico

item.title: Lindsey Vonn says surgery saved her from having her left leg amputated following Olympic crash
item.description: VAIL — American skier Lindsey Vonn says she nearly lost her left leg following a frightening crash in the women’s downhill at the Milan Cortina Olympics.

item.title: Former Colorado Parks and Wildlife ranger to pay at least $16,500 for manhunt after faking stabbing in state park
item.description: Callum Heskett pleaded guilty in court Monday to “an elaborate hoax” that sent state and county officials searching for an assailant who did not exist

item.title: Laura Clellan becomes first female director of Colorado Parks and Wildlife since divisions merged in 2011
item.description: Stakeholder group reviewed 150 applications for the job. The state commission voted unanimously Monday to confirm her.
